title: Retail Store Executive
about_us: NastaBazar is a leading name in the snacking industry, dedicated to delivering high-quality local Indian snacks, gourmet treats, and chocolates. We pride ourselves on our customer-centric approach and strive to enhance the snacking experience of our clients.
job_overview: We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Retail Store Executive to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving sales and enhancing customer satisfaction through excellent service and relationship management.

qualifications.experience: 0.6 – 3 years of experience in sales, preferably in the food and beverage industry

what_we_offer: Opportunity for professional growth and development
A dynamic and supportive work environment
how_to_apply: If you are excited about the opportunity to be a part of our team and drive sales for NastaBazar, please send your resume and a cover letter to hr@nastabazar.com. We look forward to hearing from you!
equal_opportunity: NastaBazar is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
